name: Crush the Castle 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Crush the Castle 2 is a free launch game. the original physics launch game. You are a siege master working for King Redvonian in this casual slingshot-style game. It’s up to you to defeat and bring down each kingdom. Along with the help of your other allies which include a mason, engineer, and wizard—you must create the best way and items to use in each shot. Use a catapult to toss logs onto the enemy castle to bring it down. With each level that you pass, you will be awarded different ammunition. It’s up to you to decide which would be best to take down each castle. You can use your mouse to take a view of the castle to find its weak spots and aim for them. On top of bringing down their establishments, you must also defeat the knights and bring in their royals. This casual game is also two games in one! Build your own castle and share it with your friends or other players. Build anything as simple or as complicated as you’d like. Choose from different materials to create walls and floors. You can even choose the difficulty level by selecting hills that can encase your creation. To play the game, select your item, and click again to choose the angle at which to toss your ammunition. Be careful of nature’s barriers as hills may serve to block your logs or stones.
